G2601.et: from (2596) and a derivative of the base of (939)
G2601.def: from «2596» and a derivative of the base of «939»; to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate:--bring (thrust) down.

G2602.def: from «2598»; a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception:--conceive, foundation.

G2603.def: from «2596» and «1018» (in its original sense); to award the price against, i.e. (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation):--beguile of reward.

G2605.def: from «2596» and the base of «32»; to proclaim, promulgate:--declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.

G2606.def: to laugh down, i.e. deride:--laugh to scorn.

G2607.def: from «2596» and «1097»; to note against, i.e. find fault with:--blame, condemn.

G2608.def: from «2596» and the base of «4486»; to rend in pieces, i.e. crack apart:--break.

G2609.def: from «2596» and «71»; to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel:--bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.

G2610.def: from «2596» and «75»; to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome:--subdue.

G2611.def: from «2596» and «1210»; to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound):--bind up.

G2612.def: from «2596» intensive and «1212»; manifest:--far more evident.

G2613.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «1349»; to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty:--condemn.

G2614.def: from «2596» and «1377»; to hunt down, i.e. search for:--follow after.

G2615.def: from «2596» and «1402»; to enslave utterly:--bring into bondage.

G2616.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «1413»; to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress:--oppress.

G2617.def: from «2596» and «153»; to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush:--confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-)shame(-d).

G2618.def: from «2596» and «2545»; to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly:--burn (up, utterly).

G2619.def: from «2596» and «2572»; to cover wholly, i.e. veil:--cover, hide.

G2620.def: from «2596» and «2744»; to exult against (i.e. over):--boast (against), glory, rejoice against.

G2621.def: from «2596» and «2749»; to lie down, i.e. (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal:--keep, lie, sit at meat (down).

G2622.def: from «2596» and «2806»; to break down, i.e. divide:--break.

G2623.def: from «2596» and «2808»; to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate:--shut up.

G2624.et: from (2596) and a derivative of a compound of (2819) and (1325)
G2624.def: from «2596» and a derivative of a compound of «2819» and «1325»; to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate:--divide by lot.

G2625.def: from «2596» and «2827»; to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place at table:--(make) sit down (at meat).

G2626.def: from «2596» and the base of «2830»; to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge:--overflow.

G2629.def: from «2596» and «2875»; to chop down, i.e. mangle:--cut.

G2630.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «2911»; to precipitate down:--cast down headlong.

G2632.def: from «2596» and «2919»; to judge against, i.e. sentence:--condemn, damn.

G2634.def: from «2596» and «2961»; to lord against, i.e. control, subjugate:--exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.

G2635.def: from «2637»; to be a traducer, i.e. to slander:--speak against (evil of).

G2637.def: from «2596» and the base of «2980»; talkative against, i.e. a slanderer:--backbiter.

G2638.def: from «2596» and «2983»; to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively):--apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take.

G2639.def: from «2596» and «3004» (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol:--take into the number.

G2640.def: from «2641»; a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few:--remnant.

G2641.def: from «2596» and «3007»; to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining:--forsake, leave, reserve.

G2642.def: from «2596» and «3034»; to stone down, i.e. to death:--stone.

G2643.def: from «2644»; exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor:--atonement, reconciliation(-ing).

G2644.def: from «2596» and «236»; to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference:--reconcile.

G2645.def: from «2596» and «3062»; left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest):--residue.

G2646.def: from «2647»; properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e. (by implication) a lodging-place:-- guestchamber, inn.

G2647.def: from «2596» and «3089»; to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare «2646») to halt for the night:--destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.

G2648.def: from «2596» and «3129»; to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully:--consider.

G2649.def: from «2596» and «3140»; to testify against:--witness against.

G2650.def: from «2596» and «3306»; to stay fully, i.e. reside:--abide.

G2651.et: from (2596) and accusative case plural feminine of (3441) (with (5561) implied)
G2651.def: from «2596» and accusative case plural feminine of «3441» (with «5561» implied); according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately:--alone.

G2655.def: from «2596» and narkao (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive):--be burdensome (chargeable).

G2656.def: from «2596» and «3506»; to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to:--beckon.

G2657.def: from «2596» and «3539»; to observe fully:--behold, consider, discover, perceive.

G2658.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «473»; to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively):--attain, come.

G2659.def: from «2660»; a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with «3506» or even with «3571»)) stupor (lethargy):--slumber.

G2660.def: from «2596» and «3572»; to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick"):--prick.

G2661.def: from «2596» and «515»; to deem entirely deserving:--(ac-)count worthy.

G2662.def: from «2596» and «3961»; to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain:--trample, tread (down, underfoot).

G2663.def: from «2664»; reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode:--rest.

G2664.def: from «2596» and «3973»; to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist:--cease, (give) rest(-rain).

G2665.et: from a compound of (2596) and a congener of (4072)
G2665.def: from a compound of «2596» and a congener of «4072»; something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple:--vail.

G2666.def: from «2596» and «4095»; to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively):--devour, drown, swallow (up).

G2668.def: from «2596» and «4126»; to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at:--arrive.

G2669.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «4192»; to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass):--oppress, vex.

G2670.et: from (2596) and a derivative of the same as (4195)
G2670.def: from «2596» and a derivative of the same as «4195»; to plunge down, i.e. submerge:--drown, sink.

G2672.def: middle voice from «2671»; to execrate; by analogy, to doom:--curse.

G2673.def: from «2596» and «691»; to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively:--abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.

G2674.def: from «2596» and «705»; to reckon among:--number with.

G2675.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «739»; to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust:--fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore.

G2678.def: from «2596» and «4579»; to sway downward, i.e. make a signal:--beckon.

G2679.def: from «2596» and «4626»; to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--dig down, ruin.

G2680.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «4632»; to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas «2090» refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create:--build, make, ordain, prepare.

G2681.def: from «2596» and «4637»; to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain:--lodge, rest.

G2682.def: from «2681»; an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch:--nest.

G2683.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «4639»; to overshade, i.e. cover:--shadow.

G2684.def: from «2685»; to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously:--spy out.

G2685.et: from (2596) (intensive) and (4649) (in the sense of a watcher)
G2685.def: from «2596» (intensive) and «4649» (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer:--spy.

G2686.def: middle voice from «2596» and «4679»; to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent:--deal subtilly with.

G2687.def: from «2596» and «4724»; to put down, i.e. quell:--appease, quiet.

G2688.def: from «2525»; properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor:--behaviour.

G2690.def: from «2596» and «4762»; to turn upside down, i.e. upset:--overthrow.

G2691.def: from «2596» and «4763»; to become voluptuous against:--begin to wax wanton against.

G2692.def: from «2690»; an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy:--overthrow, subverting.

G2693.def: from «2596» and «4766»; to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay):--overthrow.

G2694.def: from «2596» and «4951»; to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially:--hale.

G2695.def: from «2596» and «4969»; to kill down, i.e. slaughter:--slay.

G2697.def: from «2722»; a holding down, i.e. occupancy:--possession.

G2698.def: from «2596» and «5087»; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively):--do, lay, shew.

G2699.et: from a compound of (2596) and temno (to cut)
G2699.def: from a compound of «2596» and temno (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically):--concision. Compare «609».
